title: Gold flown to Geneva and gold certificates fund anticommunist covert operations

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher, tells Jesse Michels' podcast that in the late 1940s huge amounts of gold were flown out of Europe on US military transport planes and deposited at the International Credit Bank in Geneva, Switzerland. He says gold certificates, paper notes backed by that gold, were then issued, and he links the scheme to Allen Dulles, a US intelligence official, as a way of funding secret operations against communism. If true, it would mean early covert operations ran on a hidden fortune outside normal oversight.
